source_of_data.discovery: python3 scripts/maps_discover.py --niche "tattoo / piercing studio" --location "Plant City, FL" --limit 8 --min-rating 4.5 --min-reviews 10 -> 3 candidates; Dixie Station LLC discarded (has own website, dixiestation.com, confirmed live WordPress site 'Dixie Station Tattoo & Armory'); Giga Glam Studios LLC discarded (Google category is actually 'Health and beauty shop' / lash extensions and henna, not a real tattoo/piercing studio, saturated-niche adjacent); LuckyDawg Ink kept, category confirmed 'Tattoo shop', no website, rating 4.6, 30 reviews
source_of_data.detail: node scripts/gmaps_detail.js <mapsUrl> -> category 'Tattoo shop', address, hours, phone +1 813-704-6009, website null
source_of_data.reviews: node scripts/gmaps_reviews.js <mapsUrl> 10 -> 5 unique verbatim 5-star reviewers after de-dup (Carlos Otero, Punk Watson, Shad Fitzpatrick, Joshua Chapman, kayla bailey)
source_of_data.photos: node scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js <mapsUrl> 40 -> 9 unique Google Maps photos, all verified with 'file' as real JPEGs >15KB and viewed individually with the Read tool. 2 (gmaps-1/gmaps-2, duplicate shots of the shop's closed-sign door) kept only as supporting storefront/contact proof, not gallery tiles. Of the 7 tattoo photos, 6 kept as finished, healed work in good light (scorpio-woman forearm piece, skull/dice/flame forearm sleeve, wing/feather forearm sleeve, Captain Spaulding color portrait, flamingo script piece, voodoo-skull cartoon shin piece). 1 (gmaps-8, a name script tattoo) was DROPPED per the prohibited-in-gallery rule: visible pink/red irritation halo around the fresh lettering, consistent with a just-finished (not healed) tattoo.
source_of_data.phone_cross_check: The shop's own door signage, visible in gmaps-1.jpg/gmaps-2.jpg, prints '813-704-6009' and '1514 South Alexander St. Suite 208, PlantCity Fl. 33563', which matches the Google Business Profile phone and address exactly, independently confirming both as accurate.
source_of_data.domain_check: curl HEAD against luckydawgink.com failed at the proxy (connect_rejected), while a control domain (instagram.com) succeeded in the same session, confirming it is a genuinely non-existent domain.

reviews_verbatim.author: Carlos Otero
reviews_verbatim.text: Recently got a tattoo done and I must say I am very happy with the tattoo and the price he charged me as well I would definitely recommend anybody looking for a tattoo to stop in I can't wait for my next tattoo to stop in again

reviews_verbatim.author: Punk Watson
reviews_verbatim.text: He is a Very talented and friendly Artist, I will be going back again!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Shad Fitzpatrick
reviews_verbatim.text: Went in for an update on one tattoo and a whole new tattoo. Both look awesome and the best prices in town. Will definitely be going back for my next tattoo. Highly recommend!

reviews_verbatim.author: Joshua Chapman
reviews_verbatim.text: Dawg is an amazing artist and enjoyable to be around for hours. Great prices, clean studio. Can't wait to get the rest of my arm done!

reviews_verbatim.author: kayla bailey
reviews_verbatim.text: Dawg is absolutely amazing!!! I come out falling in love with my tattoo more and more every time. He is such an amazing artist and you come out with masterpieces that are one of a kind.

owner_identified: Artist goes by 'Dawg' (referenced by name/nickname in 3 of 5 reviews).
service_mentions_from_google: good prices, mentioned across several reviews
pricing_note: No published price list (no booking platform, no IG/FB confirmed). Reviews repeatedly mention 'great prices' / 'best prices in town' but no specific numbers. Site uses 'se cotiza, escribenos' / 'price on consultation' copy per VARIANTE ADAPTADA and omits all price fields, never invented.
gallery_curation_notes: 9 Google Maps photos downloaded, each verified with 'file' as a real JPEG >15KB, resized to max 1000px wide at quality 82, and viewed individually with the Read tool before selecting. 6 kept for the gallery (all finished, healed tattoo results in good light, no blood/irritation, no selfies): scorpio-zodiac woman forearm piece, skull/ace-of-spades/dice forearm sleeve, feather-wing forearm sleeve, Captain Spaulding color portrait, flamingo with scripture text, voodoo-skull cartoon shin piece. 1 photo (a name-script tattoo) was dropped: visible pink irritation halo around the lettering, consistent with a just-finished rather than healed tattoo, which is prohibited for the gallery. 2 photos of the shop's closed-sign door were kept only as storefront/contact proof (used in the about section), not as gallery tiles.
notes: No email or confirmed social profile found anywhere (3 Instagram handle guesses all blocked/unconfirmed). Primary contact channel is phone (call or text, +1 813-704-6009), independently confirmed against the shop's own door signage. status: staging, not deployed by this routine (no wrangler deploy run).
